messages:
maya: Quick sync: proposing 'Optimizer Lite' alpha — narrow slice of Optimize Toolkit that returns per-route batching/caching/quant recs + lightweight eval-triggered alerts. Need acceptance criteria and owners.

noah: +1. Narrow by route: /v1/chat (web) only. Models: LLaMA2-13B and redmond-v1. Exclude mobile. Cap to internal test tenants for auto-apply.

rita: For recommendations include a short rationale (e.g., 'est. 10% token savings, +4ms latency'). Show confidence (low/med/high).

sven: Eval plan: seeded set ~120 prompts, run every 4-6h, lightweight scoring (ROUGE-like + hallucination heuristics). Alert if quality drops >3% or hallucination +2%.

maya: Draft acceptance gates: 72h canary with adoption >=7% (manual+auto), no seeded-regression >2%, errors <1%. Rollback and postmortem if fail.

noah: Batching window should be percentile-driven (p95 inter-arrival) with a hard cap (50-60ms) for web. Provide expected impact estimate for each rec.

rita: Console UX: customers see read-only suggestions + opt-out toggle. Internal test orgs may auto-apply. Include 'pause recs' button and audit log on auto-changes.

sven: Telemetry: per-route token-cost delta, p50/p95/p99 latency, recommendation adoption flags (applied_by_console / auto_applied), rollback_count. Keep eval pass <2m.

maya: Owners: batching infra (noah) | eval harness (sven) | Console + explainers (rita) | telemetry/ops (ops-bot). Timeline: infra PR ~10d, eval prototype ~12d, console mock ~7d.

noah: I'll own batching infra. Prefer read-only for customers initially. Auto-apply only internal tenants.

rita: Will mock Console pieces and rationale copy. ETA mock EOW.

ops-bot: Canary cluster for /v1/chat ready. Alert hooks deployed.

maya: Great — I'll file the RFC with checklist + owners. If no objections by EOD, we create the epic and kick-off. :rocket:
